apps.localizedDescription:
Absurdly silly adventure full of racing, laughs, and surprises. Roll, jump, fly and sneeze your way to victory! 

NOT YOUR TYPICAL RACING GAME
You’re a car, but instead of wheels you have legs! Race through hundreds of unique levels by jumping, flying with jetpacks, climbing buildings, delivering packages, and pretty much everything you would NOT expect a car to do.
Hint: Look for hidden shortcuts and avoid explosives 

A WORLD TO EXPLORE
It’s not all racing. Explore the many islands to meet new friends, find hidden treasures or try your best at the quirky puzzles. 
Hint: Look behind the waterfalls!
